customFields.title: Custom Fields
customFields.description: Manage your custom fields and configurations

vitrinakiCouriers.title: Couriers
vitrinakiCouriers.subtitle: The courier shipping methods your customers see at checkout. Use your own contract with the courier.
vitrinakiCouriers.loadError: Could not load your shipping options.
vitrinakiCouriers.empty: You have not added a courier yet.

form.title: New courier shipping option
form.hint: Pick a courier, give it a name and a price. The price is flat per order.
form.trackingNumberOnly: Customer sees the tracking number (no link)
form.name: Name at checkout
form.nameHint: Customers see this, e.g. "ACS – παράδοση σε 1–3 εργάσιμες".
form.freeOverHint: When the cart's products reach this amount, shipping is free.

errors.name: Enter a name.
errors.price: Enter a price, e.g. 3.50 (0 for free).
errors.freeOver: Enter an amount above 0 or leave it empty.

noZone.title: First, a shipping zone
noZone.body: To add a courier you need a location with a shipping zone (e.g. "Greece").

soon.title: Courier integrations
soon.body: Live courier rates, voucher printing and Box Now locker choice at checkout. For now the price is flat and you create the voucher with the courier.

vitrinakiReferral.title: Refer a colleague
vitrinakiReferral.intro: Know a business that wants its own e-shop? Send them your code. You get {{percent}}% off one month of your subscription and your colleague gets a month free.
vitrinakiReferral.loadError: Could not load your referral code.
vitrinakiReferral.how1: Your colleague opens their shop from your link, or types your code when signing up.
vitrinakiReferral.how2: Once they pay their first subscription, they get a month free and you get {{percent}}% off one month: taken off your next bill or, if your subscription is on a promo code, {{days}} extra days.
vitrinakiReferral.pendingNote: Waiting discounts are added as soon as you start a subscription.
vitrinakiReferral.cap: Up to {{count}} referral rewards a year (this year: {{used}}).

welcome.applied: You signed up with a referral code: your free month has been added.
welcome.pending: You signed up with a referral code: your free month is added once your subscription starts.

vitrinakiReferral.empty: You haven't referred any shops yet.

vitrinakiPayments.title: Card payments
vitrinakiPayments.intro: Your customers pay by card and the money goes straight to your own Stripe account. You are the seller: you issue receipts, handle VAT, refunds and disputes. Vitrinaki never holds your money.
vitrinakiPayments.loadError: Could not load your payment status.
vitrinakiPayments.notConfigured: Card payments are not enabled on Vitrinaki yet. You can connect your account as soon as they are.

notConnected.text: Connect a Stripe account to accept cards in your shop. If you already use Stripe, sign in with it. Otherwise you create an account in a few minutes (you'll need your tax ID, IBAN and ID).
notConnected.hidden: Until then, card payment is not shown at your shop's checkout.

pending.text: Your Stripe account cannot accept payments yet. Continue the setup on Stripe, or wait for the review to finish.

active.text: Your shop accepts card payments. The money for each order goes into your Stripe account.
active.payoutsPending: Stripe has not enabled payouts to your bank yet. The money stays in your balance until you finish your details on Stripe.
active.refunds: Refunds: from the order page here in the Studio. The amount is refunded from your Stripe balance.

vitrinakiLoyalty.title: Customer points
vitrinakiLoyalty.subtitle: Your customers collect points with every order and trade them for a discount or free shipping, in your shop only.
vitrinakiLoyalty.loadError: Could not load your points programme.

form.enabledHint: When off, no new points are given and none can be redeemed. Customers keep the points they already have.
form.pointsPerEuroHint: Counts the value of the products in the order, without shipping.
form.rewardsHint: What customers get for their points. Up to 6 options.
form.noRewards: You haven't added a reward yet.
form.previewAmount: {{points}} points → €{{amount}} off. A customer collects them after spending about €{{spend}}.
form.previewShipping: {{points}} points → free shipping on one order.

how.title: How it works
how.earn: Only customers with an account earn points, when they complete an order in your shop.
how.redeem: Customers redeem from their cart and get a single-use code that works only here.
how.cancel: If you cancel an order, the points it gave are taken back.

errors.points: Points must be a whole number of 1 or more.
errors.noRewards: Add at least one reward to turn points on.
